messages:
olivia.prod: Heads-up: small GA for GH200 Dedicated in eu-rotterdam (eu-west-4). Limited capacity initially, targeted at customers needing high HBM and NVLink for large-context RAG and multi-shard inference.

harry.eng: Tech summary: hosts are 4x GH200-64GB. We've enabled NUMA-aware allocator + NVLink fabric tuning. Internal tests show improved HBM utilization and better KV cache scaling vs a100-80gb pools.

harry.eng: Note: throughput gains are most apparent on long-sequence workloads. Short, high-ppq micro-batch jobs may still prefer L4.

michelle.ops: Rollout plan: pool name gh200-eu-rtm-ga, soft GA starts now with per-tenant cap of 2 hosts. Customers can request increases via support with justification. SLA: standard GA SLA applies. Billing: tagged gh200-ga; billing team please finalize GA rates.

michelle.ops: Please do not assign production traffic until your AE confirms quota. We'll publish capacity snapshots weekly in #eng-ops.

billing-bot: [billing-note] tag applied: gh200-ga to pool gh200-eu-rtm-ga by michelle.ops at 2026-04-20T08:45:00Z

lina.sales: Sales note: I'll send an AE-ready blurb and canned email. Recommend calling out ideal workloads: long-context RAG, large embeddings, multi-shard LLMs.

harry.eng: SRE checklist:
- Add gh200-eu-rtm-ga to routing with fallback to a100-eu-west and a800-eu-west.
- Enable KV shard balancing and HBM pressure alerts.
- Default per-tenant host cap = 2 in GA; override via support workflow.

harry.eng: redwoodctl example to reserve a node for testing:
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool pool-gh200-rtm-01 --units 1 --duration 7d --justification "gh200 eval"
```

michelle.ops: If you observe OOMs or kernel errors, include job id + sample input and tag @harry.eng.

olivia.prod: Action items: Harry monitor perf/regressions for 2 weeks; Michelle publish weekly snapshots; Lina send AE comms and customer outreach; Billing finalize GA pricing. Post any customer access requests here so we can track.

michelle.ops: Pool health: GREEN (all nodes reporting)

olivia.prod: Thanks team 29851: will follow up with an internal FAQ and access form link in the next 24h.
